intro.h2: A founder you can reach, and the photos to back it up
paragraphs: Better Remodels handles kitchen remodeling in Orange County from its office on East Emerson Avenue in Orange. Founder Don Garcia stays close to each job, and his name comes up in review after review. Clients say he is clear about timeline and cost from the first visit.

The project gallery holds 40 finished jobs, each labeled by town, from a Garden Grove kitchen to a Huntington Beach bath. Most include before and after photos, so you can judge the work before you call. Kitchens and bathrooms are the core of the business, with full-home remodels, house extensions and ADUs for bigger plans.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Orange County, plus baths and full remodels

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Full redesigns that can move walls and update plumbing and electrical, plus custom cabinets with appliance garages and pantry storage. Counters come in granite, quartz, marble or concrete. Most full kitchen remodels take 6 to 10 weeks from demolition to the final punch list.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with white cabinets, a navy blue island, white range hood and brick-look backsplash

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Complete gut renovations with new layouts, plumbing and electrical, or focused updates. Options include walk-in showers, wet rooms, freestanding tubs, frameless glass and custom vanities with linen storage. A standard bathroom takes 3 to 5 weeks, and a large primary bath with moved plumbing can take 5 to 7.

image.alt: Bathroom remodel with a floating wood vanity, two white sinks and tall backlit mirrors

items.name: Walk-In Baths and Accessible Bathrooms
items.blurb: Walk-in tubs with inward-swinging doors, deep soaking basins and optional air or hydrotherapy jets, sized to fit standard bathtub cutouts. Accessible bath plans can add grab bars, non-slip floors and ADA-compliant layouts. Most walk-in tub installs take 1 to 5 days.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with white square floor tile, a center drain and a teak shower bench

items.name: Full Home Remodeling
items.blurb: Whole-house projects that open up floor plans, rework walls and update electrical, plumbing and HVAC. Work starts with a structural check, 3D design and permits, then moves to cabinets, flooring and lighting. A full home remodel typically runs 4 to 8 months.

image.alt: Santa Ana home remodel kitchen with pale sage upper cabinets, navy lower cabinets, a farmhouse sink and white counters

why_choose_us.h2: Why homeowners from Irvine to La Habra call Better Remodels

items.title: Prices reviewers call fair
items.text: Google's review summary quotes a client saying 'Don's prices are very fair and the work is Top Notch.' Every free estimate is detailed, written and promised to carry no hidden costs.

items.title: Job sites kept clean
items.text: Marlene I. wrote that the crew 'kept the job moving and worked clean' on her Fullerton bathroom. Another client noted the team cleaned up every day while small children were at home.

items.title: See the room in 3D first
items.text: The free in-home consultation includes design ideas, a professional 3D view of your new space, material recommendations and a project timeline, so the plan is clear before work begins.

items.title: A personal project manager
items.text: Each job has a dedicated project manager who keeps you informed with regular updates. Reviewers mention steady communication and a project that kept moving from start to finish.

about.h2: Meet Don Garcia, founder of Better Remodels
about.text: Donald Garcia, MBA, is the CEO and founder of Better Remodels, a company founded in Orange County that has been remodeling local homes for over a decade. Clients simply call him Don. Reviewers describe him setting a clear timeline and cost, then staying with the job through cleanup. The company answers its Google reviews, and one reply sums up the goal: 'No drama' might be the favorite part of a review, because 'That's always the goal.' The firm lists three values, reliability, affordability and craftsmanship, and keeps kitchens and bathrooms at the center of its work.

image.alt: Donald Garcia, CEO and founder of Better Remodels in Orange, CA

steps.title: Free in-home consultation

service_area.h2: Serving Orange and 39 more Orange County communities
service_area.text: Better Remodels works out of Suite A at 249 E Emerson Ave in Orange and lists 40 Orange County cities and communities it serves. Recent jobs include kitchens in Garden Grove, Placentia and Huntington Beach, a full remodel in Santa Ana and a bathroom in Fullerton. Live just outside the county? The team asks you to call and check whether it can take your project.

items.q: How long does a kitchen remodel take in Orange County?
items.a: Most full kitchen remodels take 6 to 10 weeks from demolition to the final punch list. The range depends on structural changes and the lead time for custom cabinets. You get a phase-by-phase timeline at your free consultation, so you know how long the kitchen will be out of use.

items.q: What does the free consultation include?
items.a: It is an in-home visit with no obligation. You get design ideas, a professional 3D visualization, material recommendations, a project timeline and a detailed written estimate with no hidden costs. Call or fill out the form, and the team gets back to you within 24 hours.

items.q: Is Better Remodels licensed and insured?
items.a: Yes. The company states that it is fully licensed, bonded and insured in California. Ask for the license number at your consultation and look it up with the Contractors State License Board before you sign, as you would with any contractor.

items.q: Can you install a walk-in tub for an older parent?
items.a: Yes. Better Remodels installs walk-in baths with inward-swinging doors, deep soaking basins and optional hydrotherapy jets, sized to fit standard bathtub cutouts. Most installs take 1 to 5 days. An accessible bathroom plan can also add grab bars, non-slip flooring and an ADA-compliant layout.

items.q: Is there a reward for referring a friend?
items.a: Yes, for full-home remodels. When someone you refer signs a qualifying full-home remodeling agreement, you each get $500 off a qualifying full-home remodel. It does not apply to single rooms or repairs unless Better Remodels confirms otherwise, and your friend should mention your name when they first call.

final_cta.h2: Ready to see your new kitchen in 3D?
final_cta.text: Call Don Garcia's team at (949) 508-0300 or request a free in-home consultation, and you will hear back within 24 hours.
